title: Photo AI: a single 40,870-line index.php making $105K/mo revenue and $80K/mo profit
summary: Pieter Levels shares that Photoai.com runs as one 40,870-line index.php file and generates $105,000/mo revenue with $80,000/mo profit. The post is a short data point showing a very simple stack can support a high-margin AI business.

principles.text: A single plain PHP file can power a business earning six figures a month; stack complexity isn't required.
principles.quote: photoai.com is a 40,870 line file called index.php

principles.text: Lean solo-built products can reach roughly 76% profit margins on $105K/mo revenue.
